source.description: Quote offsets and four historically alleged apostrophe offsets recorded in Dukotah/cicada3301, liber-primus/analysis/round43/F2-inventory/token-channels.md, from the richer relikd/scream314 runic transcription. The quote spans remain derived annotations. A 2026-11-11 audit of the correct original LP2 scans falsified the four alleged apostrophes as source-visible glyphs.

coordinate_rule: Zero-based global rune offsets over the 12,956 unsolved LP2 runes, [start,end) interval. page_slices refer to original physical LP2 page numbers; numeric-only page 50 has no runes and remains a physical page. Quotation glyphs are absent from resources/lp2-transcription.txt. The four legacy apostrophe offsets are retained only to reproduce historical experiments and are not source-visible separators.

legacy_apostrophe_hypothesis.status: retired: prior morphology audit used archive files 04/21/35/41 instead of LP2 physical pp4/21/35/41 at scans 21/38/52/58

apostrophes_before_rune_status: deprecated compatibility field; identical to legacy_apostrophe_hypothesis.before_rune and must not be treated as source evidence
